channel.title: Violations Watch: DR Congo
channel.description: New incidents reported in DR Congo. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: At least 140 Christians reported killed in eastern DR Congo over two weeks (Catholic World Report)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). DR Congo. Types: Killing of civilians. Disputed or caveats: Aggregate figure; overlaps individual incidents. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1891

item.title: Chinese national abducted and two people killed in an ambush on the Kalemie-Bendera road, Tanganyika, DR Congo (Radio Okapi)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Kalemie territory (about 42 km from Kalemie on the Kalemie-Bendera road), Tanganyika, DR Congo. Types: Abduction & hostage-taking, Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed men. Reported casualties: 2 killed. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1036

item.title: About ten civilians killed in fighting between the FARDC (with Wazalendo) and FRN rebels in Kalima grouping, Kalehe territory, South Kivu (army)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Kalima grouping, Kalehe territory, South Kivu, DR Congo. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Parties to FARDC–FRN fighting. Reported casualties: 10+ killed. Disputed or caveats: Figure from the army; FRN reported by Radio Okapi as Rwanda-backed. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0758

item.title: Series of attacks by an Islamic State affiliate in Mambasa territory, Ituri: 22–26 killed
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Mambasa territory, Ituri, DR Congo. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Islamic State affiliate (ADF). Reported casualties: 22-49 killed. Disputed or caveats: Later reports give 44–49 civilians killed across the series of attacks (Xinhua, News Central Africa). 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0472

item.title: Two attacks by unidentified armed men in Loashi, Masisi territory, North Kivu (7–8 Nov): at least ten killed, two missing
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Loashi, Masisi territory, North Kivu, DR Congo. Types: Killing of civilians, Abduction & hostage-taking. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed men. Reported casualties: 10+ killed. Disputed or caveats: Perpetrator not identified (Radio Okapi). 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0742

item.title: Armed attack on the Plaine Savo displacement site, Djugu territory, Ituri (8 Nov): at least three killed and fifteen injured (local civil society)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Plaine Savo displacement site, Djugu territory, Ituri, DR Congo. Types: Killing of civilians, Forced displacement. Alleged perpetrator: Unidentified armed assailants. Reported casualties: 3+ killed, 15+ injured. Disputed or caveats: Single local civil-society source; perpetrator not identified. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0741

item.title: ADF attack on Cantine-Aloya, Beni territory: 24–33 civilians killed with machetes, homes burned (5 Nov)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Cantine-Aloya, Beni territory, North Kivu, DR Congo. Types: Mass atrocity / genocide, Killing of civilians, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Allied Democratic Forces (ADF). Reported casualties: 24-33 killed. 11 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0024
